summary: Tested the hosted preview with real Clerk sign-in (ticket flow as Alex) plus backend pytest. Backend: a new preview suite with Clerk Bearer tokens (14/14 pass) covers clerk/config, 401 without a token, 401 for the X-PPRC-User header, 401 for an invalid bearer, 200 with a Clerk JWT, idempotent join (role player), join on an unknown club (404), photo upload/serve (200 image/*), 415 for non-images, 413 for files over 3 MB, a 404 photo path, rankings/directory, and report vs Blair with Blair confirming (self-confirm rejected). The dev-header server suite (TRIACE feed, rating flow, rules; 108 passed, 2 skipped) passes. A new repro test confirms a milestone bug: a player who enters a field of more than 10 at #1 gets only 'Club top 10', not 'No. 1'. Frontend: / landing, Sign in -> /sign-in Clerk card ('Continue to PPRC', Google, email field), /signin -> /sign-in, ticket sign-in, the session staying after a refresh, Bearer getToken 200 vs 401 without a token, /me/rating (Alex Tester, singles card, milestones, share download pprc-singles-established.png 1080x1350 PNG + 'Card downloaded'), photo upload (hero /api/v1/player-photos/...jpg, 512x512, 200 image/jpeg), non-image error alert, /rankings and /players showing Alex and his avatar image, /me/matches report vs Blair (reported + 'waiting for confirmation' callout), sign out back to the signed-out landing, and mobile 390px (no horizontal overflow on /sign-in, /players, /me/rating) all work.

minor.issue: Rank milestones check thresholds from loosest to strictest (10,5,3,1), then `break`, and set best_rank to the actual rank. A player who jumps straight to #1–#3 of a field of more than 10 gets only 'Club top 10' (with detail 'Ranked #1 of 13'), and top 5/3/No.1 can never be earned later. Repro: tests/test_milestone_rank_jump.py (dev server) -> milestones {'singles-top10'}. Fix: loop over (1,3,5,10) and award the strictest threshold reached that was not reached before, or award every newly crossed threshold.

O(n^2): `rows.index(h)` plus `next(...)` over all club history rows for every row, on every /players/me and public player call. This will slow down as the club's history grows. Group rows by rated_match_id once instead.

When the Clerk /users lookup fails (network or 5xx), requests.HTTPError is not handled, so the API returns a bare 500. Map it to 503 with a 'try again' message. Do not fall back to a default role. Also, the 401 detail says 'Use a Firebase Bearer token, or X-PPRC-User…', which is misleading in the Clerk preview.

The upload trusts the client's content_type and never checks the file's magic bytes. The file is then served with that type and without X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Validate the image signature and add nosniff.

PUT without image_url resets the photo to null. scripts/clerk_preview_testers.py does this, so every re-run (needed for each new ticket) wipes Alex's uploaded photo. Make image_url optional/unchanged when omitted, or have the script keep it.

ui_bugs.issue: A non-image shows the raw browser DOMException text 'The source image could not be decoded.' Show a friendly message such as 'Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo'. The alert also renders inline in the hero action row and pushes 'Edit profile' to the right on desktop (layout shift).

issues: It does not redirect to /sign-in. RequireUser shows an inline 'Your next match starts here' panel with a Sign in link to /signin, which then redirects. This works, but the review asked for a redirect. Optional: send the user straight to /sign-in and return them to the page afterwards.
Long names ('Club Administrator') overlap the rating number '5.00' in the card.
'Played on' uses the browser's native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn-style date picker used elsewhere.

action_items: Fix the rank milestone threshold logic in backend/app/ratings.py milestones_for (award the strictest newly reached threshold). Make tests/test_milestone_rank_jump.py pass on the dev server.
Handle Clerk user-lookup failures in _clerk_actor as 503 instead of 500, and update the 401 detail text.
Show a friendly error for non-image photo picks and stop the alert from shifting the hero buttons.
Keep image_url on PUT /players/me when it is omitted, or update clerk_preview_testers.py so it does not wipe Alex's photo.
Optional: magic-byte check and nosniff header on photos; fix the directory name/rating overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: ratings.py milestones_for threshold loop (10,5,3,1)+break gives the weakest milestone when someone jumps ranks (confirmed by repro).
milestones_for is O(n^2) on full club history per request.
clerk_auth.verify_session_token does not check the 'azp' (authorized party) claim, so any token from the same Clerk instance is accepted. This is acceptable in preview; consider it for production.
Unverified-email Clerk users can still self-join as player; only the admin role is gated on email_verified. This matches the intent.
MilestoneCard.share has no try/catch around renderCard and no busy state; a canvas failure gives an unhandled rejection and no feedback.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview suite: cd /app/backend && /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_clerk_preview_auth.py. It mints Clerk JWTs with the secret key via load_dotenv; never print the key. Dev suite: start uvicorn on :8765 with PPRC_ENVIRONMENT=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:////app/data/test.db PPRC_SEED_DEMO=false PPRC_RATE_LIMIT_WRITES_PER_MINUTE=0, then run API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765/api pytest --ignore=tests/test_clerk_preview_auth.py. test_milestone_rank_jump should pass after the fix. For UI, a ticket can be minted with clerk('/sign_in_tokens', {user_id}) without re-running the tester script, which wipes Alex's photo. Opening /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t> signs in directly; no manual Clerk.signIn needed. The players/me response nests the profile under 'profile'.
rca of the issue: Milestone rank bug: in milestones_for, `for threshold in (10,5,3,1): if rank <= threshold and (best_rank is None or best_rank > threshold) and len(ratings) > threshold: append top{threshold}; break` picks the first (loosest) threshold. best_rank is then set to the real rank (e.g. 1), so `best_rank > threshold` is false for every stricter threshold afterwards. Repro: 12 players at 6.0 play 6 matches; a 9.0-start player wins one match and is #1 of 13, but milestones = {'singles-top10'}. Mitigation: iterate (1,3,5,10) and award the first threshold the player meets that was not met before, or award every newly crossed threshold.
